壬子 = 1252, 丙辰 = 1256, 己未 = 1259 (pre-Zhongtong cyclical years).
中統初 audience undated.
English 'Prince Köten' renders 口溫不花 (Kouwen Buhua), a different prince from Köten.
完澤 and 賽羊, the crown prince's attendants, are not candidates and were not extracted.
English 'Imperial Attendants' for 徽政 (Huizheng Bureau) is loose.
